perturbations: Each ordered pair of the four blocks transfers 0.01 and 0.02 from donor to receiver: 24 fixed configurations. Sum stays one; no random search or parameter/return optimization. At live simplex boundaries omit infeasible transfers and report count.
rankings: data/revalidation_2011_2025/acreditado-38/ranking-YYYY-MM-DD.csv; the 57 manifest dates from 2011-07-02 to 2025-07-02, inclusive
eligible: finite composite, score_coverage >= 0.70 and finite Value, Quality and Momentum; retain firms with missing future returns, which are never read
scoring: Existing available-block weighted mean; missing Risk renormalizes available weights. Scores rounded to 12 decimals only for deterministic rank comparison; descending score then ascending ticker breaks ties.
metrics: Spearman and Kendall of full ordinal ranks
equal-weight sector HHI and maximum sector-weight change when all selected sectors are known
stability_score: 100 * mean overlap fraction of Top-20 under all feasible perturbations; unavailable if universe <= 20
company_labels: Baseline Top-20 included under every perturbation: persistent; some: fragile. Outside baseline Top-20 but sometimes included: near boundary; never included: outside. Inclusion fractions describe this fixed neighborhood, never future probabilities.
aggregation: Each date has equal weight; report mean, min and max for every metric; do not choose weights, dates or firms from observed performance.
sectors: No imputation of historical sectors from present-day information. Missing sector diagnostics explicitly unavailable; concentration of an equal-weight Top-N by company is mechanically 1/N.
ui: Investor: Top-20 membership persistence and position range, frozen weights. Research: all metrics, perturbation weights and firms, current experimental weights explicitly labeled. Eligibility computed before display filters.
interpretation: Descriptive structural fragility only, neither predictive evidence nor a recommendation to change weights. No backtest or blind/prospective experiment read or modified.
